verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships its own command-line entry points (`llama cli`, `llama serve`), Docker support, pre-built binaries and a dependency-free C/C++ build. All of these suit scripted, headless use. However, the evidence never explicitly documents non-interactive or batch modes, CI usage, or automation recipes, and the CLI examples shown are interactive sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/batch CLI invocation, CI pipeline guidance or examples, and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
